# Reptilians
## General Information
Reptilians can [color=lightgreen]use their tail to drag objects around, keeping both their hands free[/color].
They have sharp claws, and their unarmed attacks deal [color=hotpink]Slash[/color] damage.
The reptilian digestive system [color=palevioletred]can only process fruits and meat[/color], but they can also [color=lightgreen]digest raw meat[/color] and [color=lightgreen]blood[/color] without ill effects. They are also [color=orchid]poisoned[/color] by [color=orchid]allicin[/color] (found in garlic and onions) and [color=orchid]theobromine[/color] (found in caffeinated beverages and chocolate).
They take [color=#ffa500]30% more Cold damage.[/color] They prefer a warmer temperature range than humans.
